additional_info.subject: ID0415913-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R0 170002843] Issue in left LP CRM:02682000020
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I apologise for the delay in replying as we had a surge of tickets incoming.
I analysed the time you provided and I see that the session was stopped but then this vehicle looks like it has the Wake-up function. This means that after a stop of the session, this EV will re-attempt another session if possible.
Usually this applies for certain brands like Volvo. Can you confirm to me if you have any trucks from Volvo?
In any case, we have a hotfix for this particular issue, if you want, I can apply it, just let me know when you prefer to have this installed. But be aware that this can only be done by me as it requires special access to the charger.
My schedule is from 9am to 6pm CET.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0415913-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R0 170002843] Issue in left LP CRM:02682000020
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph, good morning.
Since this ticket is about “only starts charging after several attempts”, I am assuming this is related to the IVECO trucks. The Volvos are not having this issue and unless it's a extremely rare scenario, I will not investigate for this particular car.
If the reported that reported this is using IVECO trucks, then this makes sense as I explained in the other ticket.
Please convey the message to the customers that IVECO is working on it and will have a reply for you sometime soon.
I will keep you updated.
Best regards,
Francisco
